# 词典 S

## 概述

本页收录以字母 S 开头的实用词汇，涵盖职场、日常和技术三大场景。每个词条给出词性、含义、常见搭配与例句，另设易混淆辨析与常用短语与搭配，便于按场景查阅与记忆。

## 职场与商务

| 词汇          | 词性    | 含义           | 常见搭配                                      | 例句                                                   |
| ------------- | ------- | -------------- | --------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| stakeholder   | n.      | 利益相关者     | key stakeholder, stakeholder meeting          | We need buy-in from all stakeholders before launching. |
| strategy      | n.      | 策略，战略     | business strategy, long-term strategy         | The team revised its product strategy for Q3.          |
| supervise     | v.      | 监督，管理     | supervise a team, supervise the project       | She supervises a team of twelve engineers.             |
| submit        | v.      | 提交           | submit a report, submit a proposal            | Please submit your expense report by Friday.           |
| salary        | n.      | 薪水           | annual salary, salary negotiation             | His salary was adjusted after the performance review.  |
| schedule      | n./v.   | 日程；安排     | tight schedule, schedule a meeting            | Let me schedule a call for next Tuesday.               |
| surplus       | n./adj. | 盈余；多余的   | budget surplus, surplus inventory             | The department had a surplus of funding this quarter.  |
| streamline    | v.      | 精简，优化     | streamline the process, streamline operations | We streamlined the approval workflow to save time.     |
| subordinate   | n./adj. | 下属；次要的   | direct subordinate, subordinate role          | A good leader empowers their subordinates.             |
| scope         | n./v.   | 范围；界定范围 | project scope, scope creep                    | We need to clearly define the scope before starting.   |
| scalable      | adj.    | 可扩展的       | scalable solution, scalable business          | The architecture must be scalable to handle growth.    |
| specification | n.      | 规格说明书     | technical specification, spec document        | Review the specification before writing code.          |
| severance     | n.      | 遣散费         | severance package, severance pay              | The employee received a generous severance package.    |
| synergy       | n.      | 协同效应       | create synergy, team synergy                  | The merger created synergy between both product lines. |
| seniority     | n.      | 资历，年资     | by seniority, seniority level                 | Promotions here are based on merit, not seniority.     |
| subsidiary    | n.      | 子公司         | wholly-owned subsidiary                       | The subsidiary operates independently in Europe.       |

## 日常与社交

| 词汇          | 词性 | 含义           | 常见搭配                                       | 例句                                                 |
| ------------- | ---- | -------------- | ---------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| spontaneous   | adj. | 自发的，即兴的 | spontaneous decision, spontaneous trip         | It was a spontaneous decision to visit the museum.   |
| sufficient    | adj. | 足够的         | sufficient time, sufficient evidence           | We have sufficient supplies for the weekend.         |
| summarize     | v.   | 总结，概括     | summarize the main points                      | Can you summarize what happened at the party?        |
| subtle        | adj. | 微妙的，细微的 | subtle difference, subtle hint                 | There's a subtle difference between the two flavors. |
| sustainable   | adj. | 可持续的       | sustainable lifestyle, sustainable development | They promote a sustainable approach to fashion.      |
| skeptical     | adj. | 怀疑的         | skeptical about, remain skeptical              | I'm skeptical about the new diet trend.              |
| strengthen    | v.   | 加强，巩固     | strengthen the bond, strengthen relationships  | Traveling together can strengthen friendships.       |
| sincere       | adj. | 真诚的         | sincere apology, sincere gratitude             | She gave a sincere apology for the misunderstanding. |
| stumble       | v.   | 绊倒；偶然发现 | stumble upon, stumble over                     | I stumbled upon a great café near the park.          |
| soothe        | v.   | 安慰，缓解     | soothe the pain, soothe a baby                 | Soft music can soothe your nerves after a long day.  |
| sophisticated | adj. | 精密的；老练的 | sophisticated taste, sophisticated design      | She has a sophisticated sense of style.              |
| strive        | v.   | 努力，奋斗     | strive for excellence, strive to improve       | We strive to deliver the best user experience.       |
| sentiment     | n.   | 情感，观点     | public sentiment, market sentiment             | Public sentiment shifted after the announcement.     |

## 技术相关

| 词汇          | 词性    | 含义           | 常见搭配                               | 例句                                                   |
| ------------- | ------- | -------------- | -------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| server        | n.      | 服务器         | web server, server configuration       | The server went down during peak hours.                |
| syntax        | n.      | 语法（编程）   | syntax error, correct syntax           | A missing semicolon caused a syntax error.             |
| scalar        | n./adj. | 标量；标量的   | scalar value, scalar type              | The function returns a scalar value, not an array.     |
| snippet       | n.      | 代码片段       | code snippet, snippet library          | I saved a useful snippet for date formatting.          |
| socket        | n.      | 套接字         | WebSocket, socket connection           | The app uses WebSocket for real-time communication.    |
| sandbox       | n.      | 沙箱环境       | sandbox environment, sandbox testing   | Test the feature in the sandbox before deploying.      |
| sprint        | n.      | 冲刺迭代       | sprint planning, two-week sprint       | We completed all tasks in the current sprint.          |
| schema        | n.      | 模式，结构定义 | database schema, JSON schema           | The database schema was updated to add a new column.   |
| stack         | n.      | 技术栈；堆栈   | tech stack, full stack                 | Our tech stack includes React and Node.js.             |
| serialization | n.      | 序列化         | JSON serialization, data serialization | Serialization converts objects into a storable format. |
| singleton     | n.      | 单例           | singleton pattern, singleton instance  | The logger is implemented as a singleton.              |
| staging       | n./adj. | 预发布环境     | staging server, staging environment    | Deploy to staging first to catch bugs early.           |
| stateless     | adj.    | 无状态的       | stateless protocol, stateless API      | REST is designed as a stateless protocol.              |
| SDK           | n.      | 软件开发工具包 | mobile SDK, SDK integration            | Integrate the payment SDK into your app.               |
| SSL           | n.      | 安全套接层     | SSL certificate, SSL encryption        | Ensure the site has a valid SSL certificate.           |
| swap          | v./n.   | 交换           | memory swap, swap values               | The OS uses swap space when RAM is full.               |

## 易混淆辨析

| 词组                      | 区别说明                                                   |
| ------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| salary vs. wage           | salary 指固定月薪或年薪，wage 通常指按小时计的工资         |
| scope vs. range           | scope 侧重职责或项目范围，range 侧重数值区间或种类范围     |
| scalable vs. flexible     | scalable 强调可扩展性（随规模增长），flexible 强调灵活可变 |
| subtle vs. slight         | subtle 强调不易察觉的微妙之处，slight 强调程度小           |
| summarize vs. conclude    | summarize 指概括要点，conclude 指得出结论或结束            |
| strive vs. struggle       | strive 积极正面地努力追求，struggle 暗示困难中挣扎         |
| sincere vs. genuine       | sincere 侧重态度真诚，genuine 侧重事物真实可靠             |
| sophisticated vs. complex | sophisticated 含有精致高级之意，complex 只表示结构复杂     |

## 常用短语与搭配

| 短语          | 含义               | 例句                                                 |
| ------------- | ------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| from scratch  | 从零开始           | We built the system from scratch.                    |
| set the stage | 做好准备，奠定基础 | The research sets the stage for future development.  |
| stay on track | 保持正轨           | Regular check-ins help the team stay on track.       |
| stand out     | 脱颖而出           | Her portfolio really stood out among the applicants. |
| scale up      | 扩大规模           | We plan to scale up production next quarter.         |
| settle down   | 安定下来           | After years of traveling, he finally settled down.   |
| step up       | 加紧，提升         | We need to step up our efforts to meet the deadline. |
